title: Will Scottish football finally agree on how to fix youth development?
summary: After more than 15 years of internal debate, Scottish football is preparing a major forum to address persistent youth development challenges. The initiative represents a potential turning point in establishing consensus solutions for the country's football infrastructure.
content: For more than 15 years, Scottish football has been asking itself what it could be doing better - now it's preparing for a forum on the future of the game.
